newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-MARINERS' ALEX RODRIGUEZ ON DISABLED LIST.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-MARINERS' ALEX RODRIGUEZ ON DISABLED LIST.

text.p: The Seattle Mariners placed All-Star shortstop Alex Rodriguez on the shelf for at least a week Friday with a bruised chest wall.
Rodriguez, who was injured June 11 in a 5-1 win over the Toronto Blue Jays, was put on the 15-day disabled list retroactive to June 12.

The 21-year-old Rodriguez won the American League batting title with a .358 average last season and was runner-up to Juan Gonzalez of Texas in Most Valuable Player balloting. He hit 36 homers and had 123 runs batted in and also led the league in runs scored (141) and doubles (54).
Rodriguez is batting .316 with nine homers and 35 RBI in 62 games this season.
The Mariners lead the American League with 106 home runs and 404 runs and are second with a team batting average of .288.

To take his place on the roster, Seattle recalled left-hander Greg McCarthy from Triple-A Tacoma. McCarthy was 1-0 with a 4.66 earned run average in 28 relief appearances with the Mariners earlier this season.
